run_finetune_main: run the main function to finetune a FLAVA classification model on image, text, or vision-language data
build_config_flava: build a FLAVAArguments config using build_config to load training and dataset settings
create_datamodule_kwargs: create datamodule keyword arguments using build_datamodule_kwargs for image, text, or VL datasets
train_FLAVAClassificationLightningModule: train a FLAVAClassificationLightningModule model with a PyTorch Lightning Trainer on a selected dataset
setup_VLDataModule: setup a VLDataModule with finetuning enabled for vision-language classification tasks
